Definition: neuter plural of the superlative of the same as G2234; with great pleasure:--most (very) gladly.
BiblicalUsage: Hedista means most gladly, with the greatest pleasure, and Paul uses it twice, both times about weakness. In 2 Corinthians 12:9 he says he will most gladly glory in his infirmities, that the power of Christ may rest upon him, and in 2 Corinthians 12:15 he will very gladly spend and be spent for the Corinthians.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe most gladly is the hardest gladly in the Bible: to boast in weakness and to be spent for people who do not thank you for it.
